utterances.speaker: Robert Craigie
utterances.text: Yesterday's release on track. Two things from me — I want to talk about the streaming refactor risk, and then dependencies for 0.113.

utterances.speaker: Packy Gallagher
utterances.text: Refactor PR is up. Felix and I paired on the API. We landed on a single RetryPolicy with two execute methods — execute_sync and execute_async. Stream picks the async one, the sync memory-tool callsites pick sync. PR-456. Ready for review.

utterances.speaker: Felix Becker
utterances.text: I also narrowed the bare Exception catches in _streaming.py — three of them are now SSEError, one is a CancelledError that we deliberately let propagate. Tests passing locally.

utterances.speaker: Qing Wang
utterances.text: Agents test suite is done. Coverage on beta_session_runner is at 87 percent. I want to push it to 95 but that's a 0.113 task. Asking the room — should beta_session_runner be moved out of lib/tools? It really belongs under resources/.

utterances.speaker: Robert Craigie
utterances.text: Good question. Decision: leave it in lib/tools for now, the Stainless codegen still emits to that path. We'll move it when we do the 1.0 path cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Packy Gallagher
utterances.text: Risk on the streaming refactor — it changes the public-ish surface of Stream. If a customer was poking at Stream.retry directly, it's now Stream._retry_policy.execute_async. We should call it out in CHANGELOG.md.

utterances.speaker: Robert Craigie
utterances.text: Agreed. Action item Packy — add a migration note. We can also keep Stream.retry as a deprecated shim that delegates, for one release. Decision: dual surface for 0.112, drop the shim in 0.113.

utterances.speaker: Felix Becker
utterances.text: Last item from me — I'm taking Friday off. Robert, can you cover the on-call rotation?
